## Workflow or limitation

Who encounters the problem, and what can they not express or complete today?

## Owning layer

Does this belong to portable protocol meaning, harness mechanics, or an embedding product? Explain
only what is needed to locate the boundary.

## Smallest useful change

Describe one complete mechanism or provide a counterexample. An implementation is not required at
the proposal stage.

## How we would know

What fixture, behavior, measurement, or interoperability result would demonstrate success?
